name: logistics-website
description: Logistics TMS - monorepo root scripts (backend + frontend)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.repo:status: git status -sb && git -C backend status -sb && git -C frontend status -sb
scripts.repo:tracking: git branch -vv && git -C backend branch -vv && git -C frontend branch -vv
